newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares close weaker ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares close weaker ahead of budget.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index lost 183.14 points to close at 11,287.94 on Thursday minutes before finance minister Herbert Murerwa announced a national budget.
Brokers said the index was driven lower by weaker deals in some key counters including blue-chip conglomerate Delta, adding that some profit-taking was still evident in the market.
"The budget commences today and this may give the market a foundation on which to base a trend," one broker said.
Counters to lose on Thursday included Delta which dropped 100 cents to 2,000 while bankers NMB were down 50 cents to 350 and chrome refiners Zimbabwe Alloys lost 20 cents to 300.
Seed producers Seed-co at 400 and haulage firm Clan at 220 were both down 15 cents.

Minings were slightly more active than of late with most counters trading at previous levels. Ashanti Zimbabwe Depositories inched up five cents to 75 while copper producers Mhangura slipped two cents to 25. The seven share mining index added 1.17 points to 785.39.
